mechanical_loading_note: 73 of 82 'genuine' names are RURAL_f CONSTITUENTS — their ~+1 loading on RURAL_f is MECHANICAL (circular self-loading), so they confirm the thesis basket but are NOT independent evidence. Only 9 names load on RURAL_f significantly WITHOUT being part of it (Asian Paints, Titan, Page, Jubilant, SRF…) — these are the real cross-sectional discoveries: urban-discretionary/quality names that genuinely co-move with rural demand.
spurious_note: Per the naive-vs-clean test: a name is GENUINE only if it loads positively + significantly (|t|>=2) on RURAL_f AFTER the clean MKT_exMonsoon market control. Names that looked monsoon-linked under the naive (RURAL_f+NIFTY) test but lose significance under the clean control are SPURIOUS (market beta, not rural).
